confirmation.rule: When the first-pass deck completeness is within [trigger_min_percent, trigger_max_percent], run extra_passes more independent checker passes and take, per question, the median value of all passes. A null bound is disabled.

proof.rule: A question marked requires_proof cannot be 'found' from the deck alone. The checker must cite at least one claim whose status is proven (annex) or confirmed (web); otherwise the code caps the value at 'partial'. A question citing a claim left as 'to_probe' after review is lowered by one step.

annex_gate.rule: Fixed list. Every document below must be present, readable, and cover at least min_months when one is given. A missing or too short document stops the reading and produces the request email, document by document. There is no coverage threshold at series A: the list is the gate. Claims left uncovered after matching are listed in the report, they never stop the reading.

requirement.en: Revenue, cost of revenue, operating expenses and net burn, month by month.
requirement.fr: Revenus, coût des ventes, charges et burn net, mois par mois.

requirement.en: Revenue and logo retention by monthly acquisition cohort.
requirement.fr: Rétention du revenu et des logos par cohorte mensuelle d'acquisition.

requirement.en: Every deal with its stage, probability, amount, owner, first contact date and signature date.
requirement.fr: Chaque affaire avec son étape, sa probabilité, son montant, son propriétaire, ses dates de premier contact et de signature.

requirement.en: Every holder with its share, the option pool, and the past rounds.
requirement.fr: Chaque détenteur avec sa part, le pool d'options, les tours passés.

requirement.en: Revenue, expenses, cash and hires, month by month over 36 months.
requirement.fr: Revenus, charges, trésorerie et recrutements, mois par mois sur 36 mois.

requirement.en: The signed contract of each of the ten largest customers by ARR.
requirement.fr: Le contrat signé de chacun des dix premiers clients par ARR.

gaps.rule: A gap between a deck figure and the figure found in an annex or on the web is classified by code. Ratio = |deck - found| / max(|found|, 1). minor: ratio <= minor_max_ratio, noted, no penalty. to_probe: ratio <= probe_max_ratio, becomes a question for the call. blatant: above, or the fact does not exist; goes to the reviewer, then stops the reading if no honest explanation is found. Non-numeric contradictions (a named customer that does not exist, a key hire not on LinkedIn) are blatant by default.

web.rule: A claim is confirmed or contradicted on the web only with at least min_independent_sources sources on distinct domains, after searching both for and against. Otherwise it is unverifiable, which is a valid state, never 'probably false'. Series A adds public reviews (G2, Capterra or the sector's equivalent), open job posts, the press of previous rounds, and the LinkedIn profile of every announced key hire.

customers.proof: top 10 contracts, monthly P&L by customer

nrr.proof: cohort table: net revenue retention over 12 months

churn.proof: cohort table, churned customer list with reasons

acquisition.proof: CRM export with channel per deal, marketing spend in the P&L

pipeline.proof: CRM export with stage, probability and amount per deal

sales_cycle.proof: CRM export with first contact and signature dates

founder_sales.proof: CRM export with the owner of each signed deal

gross_margin.proof: monthly P&L: revenue and cost of revenue

burn_multiple.proof: monthly P&L: net burn and net new ARR

pricing.proof: top 10 contracts showing the price paid

named_customer.proof: top 10 contracts; customer website, LinkedIn, public review

competitor.proof: competitor websites, public reviews of the category

key_hire.proof: LinkedIn profile of the hire with that role at the company

reviews.proof: G2, Capterra or the sector's review site

funding.proof: cap table, press of the previous rounds, registry

market.proof: public data behind the bottom-up figures

question.en: Which segment buys, and do the last ten customers match it?
question.fr: Quel segment achète, et les dix derniers clients y correspondent-ils ?

questions.found_if: A nameable profile (size, role, sector), and the last ten signed customers fit it, checked against the contracts.
questions.note: A segment that changes with every customer is not a repeatable machine.

question.en: Why do they buy, and why do they renew, in their own words?
question.fr: Pourquoi il achète, et pourquoi il renouvelle, dans ses mots ?

questions.found_if: A customer quote for the purchase and one for the renewal, or a documented use case with both.

question.en: What was tried and dropped since the seed?
question.fr: Qu'est-ce qui a été essayé et abandonné depuis le seed ?

questions.found_if: A segment, channel or feature abandoned since the seed round, dated, with what triggered it.
questions.note: Nothing dropped since seed = partial at best.

question.en: ARR today, and the monthly curve over 24 months?
question.fr: ARR aujourd'hui, et la courbe mensuelle sur 24 mois ?

questions.found_if: An ARR figure and the monthly revenue points over 24 months, matching the P&L.
questions.note: A growth percentage without its starting point = absent.

question.en: How many paying customers, and the average contract value by segment?
question.fr: Combien de clients payants, et le contrat moyen par segment ?

questions.found_if: A customer count and an ACV per segment, backed by the contracts or the P&L.

question.en: Year-over-year growth, with the starting point?
question.fr: Croissance sur un an, avec le point de départ ?

questions.found_if: Two dated ARR points twelve months apart and the ratio.
questions.note: Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: Do the named customers exist, pay, and use the product?
question.fr: Les clients nommés existent-ils, paient-ils, et utilisent-ils le produit ?

questions.found_if: Confirmed outside the deck: a contract in the annexes, and a website, LinkedIn page or public review.
questions.note: Still the central question. Cannot be found from the deck alone. Absent = red.

question.en: How much of ARR do the top ten customers make?
question.fr: Quelle part de l'ARR font les dix premiers clients ?

questions.found_if: A share of ARR for the top ten customers, confirmed against the contracts or the P&L.
questions.note: A single customer above 40 % of ARR is a question for the call, not a verdict.

question.en: Where do customers come from, channel by channel?
question.fr: D'où viennent les clients, canal par canal ?

questions.found_if: Each channel with its share of new ARR, from the CRM export.
questions.note: All from one channel = partial.

question.en: Gross margin, confirmed against the P&L?
question.fr: Marge brute, confirmée contre le P&L ?

questions.found_if: A gross margin with what is included in cost of revenue, and the same figure in the P&L.
questions.note: A margin that excludes hosting or support = partial.

question.en: Customer acquisition cost by channel, and payback?
question.fr: Coût d'acquisition par canal, et délai de récupération ?

questions.found_if: A CAC per channel with the method, and the months to recover it.

question.en: Sales cycle by segment?
question.fr: Cycle de vente par segment ?

questions.found_if: An average duration from first contact to signature, per segment, from the CRM export.
questions.note: B2B only. Weight 0 in B2C.

question.en: Burn multiple?
question.fr: Burn multiple ?

questions.found_if: Net burn divided by net new ARR over the last twelve months, both figures from the P&L.
questions.note: Benchmark shown next to the figure (Sacks, Bessemer), never in the score.

question.en: Weighted pipeline, and how much of next year's plan does it cover?
question.fr: Pipeline pondéré, et quelle part du plan de l'année suivante il couvre ?

questions.found_if: A pipeline by stage with probabilities, its weighted total, and the ratio to the plan, from the CRM export.
questions.note: An unweighted pipeline = partial.

question.en: What share of deals closed without a founder?
question.fr: Quelle part des ventes a été conclue sans fondateur ?

questions.found_if: A share of signed deals whose owner in the CRM is not a founder.
questions.note: The question that separates series A from seed. Absent = red.

question.en: Net revenue retention over twelve months?
question.fr: Rétention nette du revenu (NRR) sur douze mois ?

questions.found_if: An NRR over a twelve-month window with the definition used, recomputable from the cohorts.
questions.note: Benchmark shown next to the figure, never in the score.

question.en: Gross retention and logo churn, with the reasons?
question.fr: Rétention brute et churn logo, avec les raisons ?

questions.found_if: A gross revenue retention or logo churn figure, and a reason per lost customer.
questions.note: Absent = the deck hides churn. Red.

question.en: Do the cohorts flatten, over twelve months or more?
question.fr: Les cohortes s'aplatissent-elles, sur douze mois et plus ?

questions.found_if: Cohort curves of at least twelve months, with the month where they flatten.

question.en: Which customers expanded, and why?
question.fr: Quels clients ont grossi, et pourquoi ?

questions.found_if: Named customers or a share of ARR from expansion, with the trigger (seats, modules, price).

question.en: Market size computed bottom-up with the observed ACV?
question.fr: Taille du marché par le bas, avec l'ACV constaté ?

questions.found_if: Possible customers in the segment multiplied by the ACV actually signed, with visible assumptions.
questions.note: An analyst figure = absent.

question.en: Who are the competitors, where do they win, and who was lost to them?
question.fr: Qui sont les concurrents, où gagnent-ils, et qui leur a été perdu ?

questions.found_if: Named competitors, one point where each wins, and deals lost to them.
questions.note: Web check: omitted competitors become a contradiction.

question.en: Why now, and why still?
question.fr: Pourquoi maintenant, et pourquoi encore ?

questions.found_if: A recent, named, verifiable change, and why the window is still open two years later.

question.en: Who did what before, verifiably?
question.fr: Qui a fait quoi avant, vérifiable ?

questions.found_if: Named achievements, confirmed on LinkedIn or elsewhere.
questions.note: A title without a result = partial.

question.en: Do the announced key hires exist?
question.fr: Les recrutements clés annoncés existent-ils ?

questions.found_if: Each key hire named in the deck (VP Sales, VP Engineering...) found on LinkedIn with that role at the company.
questions.note: A VP Sales on a slide who is not on LinkedIn is a contradiction. Absent = red.

question.en: Do the open job posts match the plan?
question.fr: Les offres d'emploi ouvertes correspondent-elles au plan ?

questions.found_if: Public job posts that correspond to the hiring plan of the round.
questions.note: No open post while the deck plans ten hires: a question for the call.

question.en: Who owns what, and is everyone full-time?
question.fr: Qui possède quoi, et tout le monde est-il à temps plein ?

questions.found_if: Founders, investors, employees and option pool shares from the cap table, and full-time status per founder.

question.en: How much is asked, and what for, hire by hire?
question.fr: Combien demandé, à quoi ça sert, recrutement par recrutement ?

questions.found_if: An amount and a breakdown by function with the hiring plan.

question.en: What figures must be reached for series B?
question.fr: Quels chiffres à atteindre pour la série B ?

questions.found_if: A measurable, dated goal: ARR, NRR, burn multiple.
questions.note: Absent = the money has no purpose. Red.

question.en: Runway and burn on the three-year model?
question.fr: Runway et burn sur le modèle à trois ans ?

questions.found_if: Monthly burn, cash, and the months of runway, consistent with the financial model.

question.en: Previous rounds: amounts, investors, and do they follow on?
question.fr: Tours précédents : montants, investisseurs, et remettent-ils au pot ?

questions.found_if: Amounts and investors for each round, in the cap table and the press, and whether existing investors follow on.
questions.note: The press of previous rounds is checked on the web.

question.en: Customers we can call, including one that left?
question.fr: Des clients qu'on peut appeler, dont un qui est parti ?

questions.found_if: Names and a way to contact them, including at least one lost customer.

question.en: Former colleagues, investors or key hires we can call?
question.fr: Des anciens collègues, investisseurs ou recrutements clés qu'on peut appeler ?

questions.found_if: Same.
questions.note: Asked to prepare the call, not to judge the deck.
